data.one_liner: A platform interface for the just_audio plugin, defining the contract for platform-specific implementations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a common API that all just_audio platform implementations must follow, ensuring consistency across Android, iOS, web, and desktop. It exposes methods for audio playback control, configuration, and event streams.
use_when: You need to create a custom platform implementation for just_audio.
You want to ensure your plugin stays compatible with future just_audio releases.
avoid_when: You only need to use just_audio itself without custom platform code.
strengths: Simplifies plugin development by centralizing API definitions.
Supports future feature extensions via interface updates.
weaknesses: Only an interface; no functionality on its own.
Requires a separate implementation to be useful.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and implement JustAudioPlatform subclass.
